rationale: When untrusted package detonation triggers an unexpected crash, credential theft attempt, or environment corruption at Step 7, continuing or simply resuming execution leaves the guest filesystem in a dirty, potentially compromised state. Applying policy 'rollback' restores the clean copy-on-write hardware snapshot captured at Step 6 in under 200 milliseconds, purging malicious filesystem artifacts and memory hooks instantly while maintaining test continuity without the high latency and cost of a cold reboot.
